title: Modelling Viable Supply Networks with Cooperative Adaptive Financing
byline: Y Proselkov, L Xu, A Brintrup (2026). arXiv preprint.
blurb: Proposes a decentralised financing mechanism to improve supply chain viability using cooperative adaptation.

title: Towards Autonomous Supply Chains: Definition, Characteristics, Conceptual Framework, and Autonomy Levels
byline: L Xu, S Mak, Y Proselkov, A Brintrup (2024). Journal of Industrial Information Integration.
blurb: Establishes a foundational framework and autonomy levels for the transition toward fully autonomous supply chains.

title: Financial Ripple Effect in Complex Adaptive Supply Networks: An Agent-Based Model
byline: Y Proselkov, J Zhang, L Xu, E Hofmann, T Choi, D Rogers, A Brintrup (2023). International Journal of Production Research.
blurb: Investigates how financial distress propagates through complex supply networks using an agent-based approach.

title: Implementation of Autonomous Supply Chains for Digital Twinning: A Multi-Agent Approach
byline: L Xu, Y Proselkov, S Schoepf, D Minarsch, M Minaricova, A Brintrup (2023). IFAC-PapersOnLine 56(2), 11076–11081.
blurb: Details a multi-agent system architecture for creating digital twins of autonomous supply chains.

title: The Value of Information for Dynamic Decentralised Criticality Computation
byline: Y Proselkov, M Herrera, M Perez-Hernandez, AK Parlikad, A Brintrup (2022). IFAC-PapersOnLine 55(2), 408–413.
blurb: Explores decentralised methods for assessing node criticality in dynamic networks based on information value.

title: Mining Graph-Fourier Transform Time Series for Anomaly Detection of Internet Traffic at Core and Metro Networks
byline: M Herrera, Y Proselkov, M Perez-Hernandez, AK Parlikad (2021). IEEE Access 9, 8997–9011.
blurb: Applies Graph-Fourier transforms to detect anomalies in large-scale telecommunication traffic data.

title: Distributed Dynamic Measures of Criticality for Telecommunication Networks
byline: Y Proselkov, M Herrera, AK Parlikad, A Brintrup (2020). SOHOMA, 1–12.
blurb: Introduces distributed algorithms for computing criticality metrics in evolving telecommunication infrastructures.

title: Scalable Autonomous Network Control using Minimally Informed Agents
byline: PhD Thesis, University of Cambridge, Institute for Manufacturing, Christ's College (2024).
blurb: Doctoral research developing scalable control mechanisms for complex networks utilizing agents with limited local information.

title: Triple-Jumping over Fragmentation, Epidemics, and Spontaneous Adaption
byline: MSc Thesis, University of Bristol, Department of Engineering Mathematics (2018).
blurb: Master's thesis examining fragmentation and spontaneous adaptation in network epidemic models.

title: Exploring bounds of the 3 state misanthrope interacting particle system to ensure stationarity and translation-invariance, with other results
byline: BSc(Hons) Thesis, University of Bristol, Department of Mathematics (2017).
blurb: Bachelors's thesis studying the nonstationary behaviour of 3 state misanthropic interacting particle systems.

title: Bridging Universities, Capital, and Real-World Projects: A Translational Framework for Impact Measurement
byline: S Choo, S Castello, Y Proselkov (2026). SSRN preprint.
